method: Spot list from the Surfnerd country pages (surf-reports/<country>), the Surf-Forecast.com country break lists and the Wannasurf South America zone pages; facts from each Surfnerd .md page and the matched Surf-Forecast.com and Wannasurf pages (matched by name and position), fetched about 1 per second per site. Facing and position come from Surfnerd (the only guide that states a facing). Time zone: the IANA zone in the Surfnerd page front matter, accepted only if it is a tzdb zone for that country. Nearest sources: wave buoys and tide gauges from the EMODnet Physics platform registry (ERDDAP EP_PLATFORMS_METADATA_V2, which lists the Brazilian national moored buoys and the SHOA, DHN, INOCAR, IBGE, SiMCosta and SHN tide gauges), tide gauges from the IOC Sea Level Station Monitoring Facility, METAR airports from the Iowa Environmental Mesonet national networks, and NOAA NDBC activestations (here only DART tsunami stations and PIRATA/Stratus moorings, no wave data). live = last observation on or after 2026-11-06 (EMODnet), status active with observations in the last day (IOC), online flag (IEM). PNBOIA was not queried directly (blocked in the source survey).
